definitions.gloss: late at night, the dead of night
definitions.explanation: The late hours of the night, typically after midnight.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}まで{仕事|しごと}をしていた。
examples.english: I was working until late at night.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}{番組|ばんぐみ}を{見|み}るのが{好|す}きだ。
{深夜|しんや}{営業|えいぎょう}のコンビニは{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores open late at night are handy.

notes:
{深夜|しんや} refers to late night hours, typically after midnight.

Common collocations:
- {深夜|しんや}{番組|ばんぐみ} (late-night TV program)
- {深夜|しんや}{営業|えいぎょう} (late-night business hours)
- {深夜|しんや}バス (late-night bus)
- {深夜|しんや}{料金|りょうきん} (late-night surcharge)
- {深夜|しんや}に (late at night)

Time-of-day vocabulary:
- {早朝|そうちょう} (early morning)
- {朝|あさ} (morning)
- {昼|ひる} (noon, daytime)
- {夕方|ゆうがた} (evening)
- {夜|よる} (night)
- {深夜|しんや} (late night)
- {真夜中|まよなか} (midnight)
